name: Mizuiro
summary: Western fans had mistakenly referred to the 2020s revival of Mizuiro as Tenshi Kaiwai (天使界隈, Angel Community); this is actually the community hashtag of the Tenshi Zyoshi magazine/blog that featured the aesthetic, not the aesthetic itself.
description:
Western fans had mistakenly referred to the 2020s revival of Mizuiro as Tenshi Kaiwai (天使界隈, Angel Community); this is actually the community hashtag of the Tenshi Zyoshi magazine/blog that featured the aesthetic, not the aesthetic itself. It is also sometimes misspelled as "Tenshi Kawaii," which the Japanese community does not use.

The community for this aesthetic creates content on Instagram and TikTok, which can be found by searching 水色界隈 (mizuiro community), 水色サブカル (mizuiro subculture), and 水色雰囲気 (mizuiro aesthetic).
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Innocence, fragility

visualDNA.colour: Light blue, turquoise, white, sometimes grey

fashion.Overview: While the aesthetic covers a wide range of styles, there is a few elements that are characteristic of mizuiro fashion.
fashion.Classic Mizuiro (2010s): This fashion style mainly consists a light blue color scheme, usually with hints of sportiness or techwear influences like tracksuits, hoodies, etc. Sometimes flared leg warmers are included. Usually features kawaii imagery or a general soft feel, and is paired with old web aesthetics.
